title: Logistic derivative lower bound
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $0<p<1$. The derivative of its biased-minus probability polynomial at $p$ is at least the polynomial’s value at $p$ times one minus that value, divided by $p(1-p)$.
